t='((..(((..((((..((....((..((((....))....))..))))..))....))..))((..((..((..((((..((....((..((((..((....((....))))..))....))..))))..))((..((..((....))((..((((..((....((..((((....))....))..))))..))....))..))))..))..))..))((..((....((..((((..((....((....))))..))....))..))))..))))..))..)..))'
n=len(t)
stack=[]; pairs=[]
for i,c in enumerate(t):
    if c=='(':
        stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop(); pairs.append((j,i))
paired=set()
for i,j in pairs: paired.add(i); paired.add(j)

# Build stems: group consecutive pairs into stacks
# For each closing pair region, assign GC stack with 5'->G/C alternating to avoid runs
seq=['A']*n
# tetraloop hairpins -> GAAA
hairpin_loops=[(29,32),(103,106),(141,144),(171,174),(245,248)]
for (a,b) in hairpin_loops:
    for k,p in enumerate(range(a,b+1)):
        seq[p]=['G','A','A','A'][k]

# Assign stem pairs: use GC with alternation to avoid GG runs
# sort pairs by 5' position
pairs_sorted=sorted(pairs, key=lambda x:x[0])
for k,(i,j) in enumerate(pairs_sorted):
    # alternate to avoid runs: even -> G/C, odd -> C/G
    if k%2==0:
        seq[i]='G'; seq[j]='C'
    else:
        seq[i]='C'; seq[j]='G'

# multiloop/junction unpaired -> A (already A)
s=''.join(seq)
print(s)
print(len(s))

cat > /tmp/sa.py << 'PYEOF'
import RNA, random, time, math
RNA.params_load_RNA_Turner2004()
md=RNA.md(); md.dangles=2; md.temperature=37.0
target='((..(((..((((..((....((..((((....))....))..))))..))....))..))((..((..((..((((..((....((..((((..((....((....))))..))....))..))))..))((..((..((....))((..((((..((....((..((((....))....))..))))..))....))..))))..))..))..))((..((....((..((((..((....((....))))..))....))..))))..))))..))..)..))'
n=len(target)
# paired positions
paired=set()
stack=[]
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(': stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop(); paired.add((j,i)); paired.add((i,j))
paired_mask=[i for i,c in enumerate(target) if c in '()']
unpaired_mask=[i for i,c in enumerate(target) if c=='.']

def ffold(seq):
    fc=RNA.fold_compound(seq,md,0); r=fc.mfe(); return r[0]

def bpdist(fs):
    return sum(1 for x,y in zip(fs,target) if x!=y)

def score(seq):
    fs=ffold(seq)
    return bpdist(fs), fs

# init: GC for pairs, A for loops
seq=list('A'*n)
# place GC/AU on pairs
pairlist=[]
stack=[]
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(': stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop(); pairlist.append((j,i))
for k,(i,j) in enumerate(pairlist):
    if k%2==0: seq[i]='G'; seq[j]='C'
    else: seq[i]='C'; seq[j]='G'
seq=''.join(seq)

best=seq[:]; best_d,best_fs=score(seq)
cur=seq[:]; cur_d=best_d; cur_fs=best_fs
t0=time.time(); DEADLINE=95
rng=random.Random(7)
it=0
T=2.0
while time.time()-t0<DEADLINE:
    it+=1
    # pick a position to mutate
    p=rng.randrange(n)
    old=cur[p]
    # choose new base, biased by whether paired
    nt=rng.choice('ACGU')
    if nt==old: continue
    cand=cur[:p]+nt+cur[p+1:]
    d,fs=score(cand)
    if d<=cur_d or rng.random()<math.exp(-(d-cur_d)/T):
        cur=cand; cur_d=d; cur_fs=fs
        if d<best_d:
            best_d=d; best=cand; best_fs=fs
            print("it",it,"best_d",best_d,flush=True)
    if it%200==0:
        T=max(0.3,T*0.995)
print("FINAL it",it,"best_d",best_d,flush=True)
print(best,flush=True)
open('/tmp/sa_out.txt','w').write("best_d=%d\n%s\n%s\n"%(best_d,best,best_fs))
